legacySummary: The legacy body is a template shell (payload metadata: model "template-engine", source "national_curriculum_generation", estimated cost 0). Its ten sections describe what a teacher should do ("Model one complete math example…") but contain no numbers, place names, examples, questions or answers.
`delivery.bodyBlock` (Day 1, Day 2, Home Support) repeats sentences from the same sections; it adds no material.

The only concrete material is one offline lab, "Understanding Place Value with Local Materials" (25 minutes, 3 steps): leaves, stones and cassava stand for tens, ones and hundreds; learners build a number such as 123 and record it. Its two analysis questions ask how 345 breaks into hundreds, tens and units (expected "3 hundreds, 4 tens, and 5 units") and why place value matters.
Assessment is a sentence ("a short exit task with two checks…"); `assessmentQuestions` and `problemSets` are empty, so the legacy lesson has no keyed items to compare.
Standards: a keyword alignment (confidence low) to LiberiaLearn code LR-MATH-G7_9-04, "Apply the Pythagorean theorem and basic trigonometric ratios". The payload's own `moeAlignments` is empty.

Governance: row status APPROVED, payload approvalStatus pending_approval, provenance UNVERIFIED with origin LEGACY_UNKNOWN (single BACKFILL_SNAPSHOT revision). Payload metadata nevertheless says qualityValidated: true and marks every section complete.

alignment.question: Should place value through the thousandths remain a Grade 7 prerequisite/reinforcement lesson supporting decimals, fractions and percentages?
evidence: MOE Grade 7 Math (Math 7-9 pp.2-16) has six periods: Arithmetic skills and Sets (S1 P1), Fractions (P2), Decimals, percents and fractions (P3, p.10), Basic algebra (S2 P4), Geometry (P5), Co-ordinate geometry (P6). None has a place-value objective (test: "the structured source has no Grade 7 objective…").

Grade 7 P3 (p.10): obj1 "Convert from decimal to percent/fraction and vice versa"; obj2 "Apply decimal and percent to the solution of problems involving commissions, discounts, taxes, interest, profits and losses and rayolty" [sic]. Both use decimal place value.

Earlier grades: G3 place value to thousands (Math 1-6 p.26); G4 read/write and compare whole numbers to hundred thousand (p.38) and decimals to hundredths (p.45); G5 multiply and divide whole numbers and decimals; G6 "Round off decimals to the nearest tenth, hundredths and thousandths" (p.67).
The word "million" does not occur in the extracted Math 1-6 or Math 7-9 text (curriculum/sources/intermediate).
The legacy row is lesson 1 of LiberiaLearn unit math-g7-1-number-sense-and-place-value; MOE Grade 7 period 1 is Arithmetic skills and Sets, not number sense.

options.label: Keep as a prerequisite/reinforcement lesson before P3
options.description: Keep the three objectives as LiberiaLearn candidates with their PREREQUISITE_FOR relationships to Math 7-9 p.10, placed before the decimals, percents and fractions period. Millions stay as a labelled extension of the Grade 4 range.
options.consequences: No content change. The authority must accept a LiberiaLearn extension beyond any MOE grade (millions).

options.label: Keep, but rescope to decimal place value
options.description: Make tenths to thousandths (reading, digit value, comparing) the core, matching G4 p.45 and G6 p.67 and feeding P3 directly. Whole numbers above hundred thousand become optional enrichment.
options.consequences: Revise intro, chart, worked-example, practice items 1-3 and exit items 1, 3 and 6 (or mark them enrichment); regenerate the package.

options.label: Use as a diagnostic/remediation resource only
options.description: Remove the lesson from the Grade 7 core sequence and offer it when the warm-up or P3 work shows place-value gaps.
options.consequences: No Grade 7 core objective. Retiring or repointing the legacy unit needs a separate authorized change that respects its learner history.

alignment.authorRecommendation: A, placed as a prerequisite to Math 7-9 P3 rather than as unit 1 core content, with millions labelled as a LiberiaLearn extension. This is the author's recommendation, not a decision; a qualified Math reviewer and the curriculum authority decide.
